summary: Use the generated collection by calling cidrblock.my_collection.myos_interfaces and myos_facts, then inspecting ansible_network_resources.
questions: How do I call a generated resource module from a playbook?
Where do resource facts end up?

answer_card.title: Use the generated collection
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: myos101
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - cidrblock.my_collection.myos_interfaces:
      register: result
    - debug: { var: result }
    - cidrblock.my_collection.myos_facts:
    - debug: { var: ansible_network_resources }
```
